name: Chromium Ad Blocker
author: omarchy.fans
description: Removes ads, popups and sales offers in Chromium, declines tracking-cookie dialogs, blocks third-party trackers and sends Global Privacy Control, and clears legal popups without agreeing to anything. Rules and page heuristics act instantly; an optional model on your own GPU classifies the rest. The bar button shows what it has removed.

barWidget.description: Shows ads, trackers and popups removed; click for status and statistics.
